description: $0.02 USDC on Solana — the payment buys one version-safety verdict covering one to four official MCP reference servers you run: per server, a deterministic SAFE / UPGRADE REQUIRED / STILL EXPOSED / UNKNOWN verdict computed from the published advisory dataset, the matched advisories with GHSA ids and affected ranges, the exact version that clears every advisory in the dataset, and the published residual gaps a SAFE verdict still carries. A version the dataset cannot judge is reported UNKNOWN, never guessed.

servers.description: One to four entries, one per reference server you run.

package.description: The reference server package (canonical name or short name).

version.description: The version you run, exactly as installed.

name: mcp_version_check
